rationale: The majority is likely to resolve the case narrowly on § 1252(f)(1), holding that the requested programmatic injunction would "enjoin or restrain" Part IV’s operation (per Aleman Gonzalez), without definitively deciding the full reach of § 1252(b)(9) for all front-end claims. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Alito (to press broader jurisdiction-stripping) and from Sotomayor/Kagan/Jackson (to emphasize the "no proceeding, no forum" gap and argue for some limited district-court avenue or narrower remedies).
